text: We are at Harmattan General Hospital emergency right now. My husband had an accident and is bleeding badly but they say we must pay 80,000 deposit before they touch him.
Abeg help, my mama no fit breathe, we dey Iroko District Hospital now now, dem say no bed space, dem no gree attend to am.
My wife is in labour and bleeding at Sunbird Mother and Child Hospital. The nurses said no doctor is around and nobody is attending to her. It is happening now.
Dem hold my brother for Lagoon View General Hospital since three days because we never complete the bill. Dem no gree make e comot, e still dey there.
My father died on Tuesday at Palm Grove Teaching Hospital and they are refusing to release his body until we pay 350,000 naira. We are still here begging.
My pikin dey convulse for children emergency, nurse talk say make we go buy card and pay before doctor go see am. We dey here as I dey type.
My newborn baby is on the ward and has not been checked since last night. She is not feeding and looks very weak, and the nurses keep saying wait.
They brought in my neighbour unconscious after he collapsed. The hospital says without a police report and a deposit they will not treat him. Please what do we do, we are at the gate.
Na so dem abandon my grandma for corridor since morning, she dey critical, nobody answer us till now.
Last month a nurse at Harmattan General Hospital maternity slapped my sister during labour and called her a useless girl.
Last week for Lagoon View, one nurse dey shout for my mama, she insult am well well for front of everybody because she ask question.
In June when my son was admitted at Iroko District Hospital children's ward, there was no doctor on the ward throughout the weekend.
Two weeks ago we were told to pay 20,000 before they would attend to my mother's asthma attack at the emergency unit. We paid and she was treated, she is home now.
E don tey small, like two months, dem hold my cousin wife for hospital for one week after she born because of 45k bill.
The records staff humiliated my elderly father last week, made him kneel to beg for his file at Palm Grove.
Yesterday night on the ward I pressed for help many times because my mother's drip had finished. Nobody came for three hours.
The way they treat people in that hospital is very bad, I am not happy at all with what happened to us.
Dis hospital people wicked. Dem no send anybody at all at all.
They have not attended to us since we came.
I am a nurse at Iroko District. Management tells us to collect deposits before touching emergency patients. It happens every night.
The doctor at Lagoon View gave my daughter the wrong diagnosis, said malaria when it was appendicitis. It was last year.
I believe the surgery they did on my knee in March was done badly, I still cannot walk well.

My wife delivered three weeks ago at Marula Springs and they have refused to let her and the baby leave because the bill is 85,000 shillings. She is still in the ward under guard.

I am a doctor doing my house job at Palm Grove Teaching Hospital. Consultants tell us not to admit any accident victim until the family has paid. I have seen three people die at the gate this month.
I be cleaner for Harmattan General Hospital. For night shift, nurses dey sleep, nobody dey answer patient wey dey call for help for female ward. E dey happen every night.
Last week my mother was on admission at Lagoon View General Hospital and the nurse on duty told us she is a nurse not a servant, then refused to help turn her in bed for the whole night.

I am a nurse myself at a private clinic, so I know how things should be done. Last month I was a patient at Iroko District Hospital for my delivery and the midwife slapped my thighs and shouted at me.
I was visiting my friend on the ward at Sunbird yesterday and I saw a nurse drag an old woman out of her bed and shout at her for wetting it. The woman is not my relative, I just saw it.
